title: Chapter 77 Announcement Of Ranking List
content:
Chapter 77 Announcement Of Ranking List

This group of people are all women, and the leader is wearing a black veil.

When Chef Zhang saw this group of women, he immediately stood up and said to Wang Shuo: "I will introduce you to a powerful person."

He walked a few steps towards the door and said to the woman wearing a black veil: "Master Yue Ji, welcome to your presence!"

Wang Shuo also stood up. I guess the powerful person that Chef Zhang wanted to introduce was the Master Yue Ji.

"I am the Lord of Wana Village, Wang Shuo."

"I am the Fiery Rose, Yue Ji." The black veiled woman looked at Wang Shuo and his subordinates, and the pleasant voice came out from the black veil.

Suddenly, Ou Fulan, who was standing behind Yue Ji, stood up and shouted: "It was him who stole our purple spirit flower."

This scream broke the calm and peaceful atmosphere.

Only then did Wang Shuo notice that this woman was the one who led the bees to him and then ran away.

He already had some dislike for her, and her act of turning the tables on him made Wang Shuo write her name on the "Diary" page.

For the sake of Chef Zhang, he did not get angry on the spot.

"You stole my subordinates' things?" Her tone changed, and her voice was a little cold.

Wang Shuo's eyes flashed, and he glanced at Chef Zhang. In the end, he patiently explained the situation at that time.

"Boss, it's not like that, he lied." O'Flan said angrily.

Chef Zhang saw that the two sides were on the verge of a fight, and was about to make peace.

Suddenly, there was a lot of noise on the street.

"Go and see, the list is posted in the square!"

A large number of people ran towards the square in the center of Nanshan Market.

"Humph! Let's go!" Yue Ji snorted coldly, and left with O'Flan and others.

Wang Shuo was also full of curiosity.

In the past, didn't the rankings use the system announcement directly?

Why is there a list this time?

"Let's go and have a look!" He said, looking at Chef Zhang, "Old Zhang, how much is this meal?"

"Between you and me, what's the price? Just treat it to me!" Chef Zhang said straightforwardly.

"Well, I'll come to see you when I have time!" Wang Shuo said with a smile.

Following the flow of people, Wang Shuo soon came to the center of a small square.

Three huge stone tablets were erected on the square.

There was a faint light flickering on it, and in the blink of an eye, some words appeared on it.

At the same time, the system prompts sounded in the minds of every player.

[Changping County Personal Level List]

First place: Ni Wu (level 30).

Second place: Zhang Jinsheng (level 26).

Third place: Xie Fan (level 25).

...

Tenth place: Tianwu (level 21).

Wang Shuo looked and saw that Ayub's level was already level 21, but he was not on the list. I don't know if it was because he was a tool man, so he was not on the list.

[Changping County Village Strength List]

First place: Wana Village (Wang Shuo)

Second place: Jiuyuan Village (Su Xiu)

Third place: Fengze Village (Zhao Tianze)

…

Tenth place: Baiyang Village (Yang Zeshan)

[Changping County Comprehensive Strength List]

First place: Ni Wu (Iron Sword Gate)

Second place: Wang Shuo (Wana Village)

Third place: Su Xiu (Jiuyuan Village)

…

Tenth place: Zhuge Kewei (Wild Wolf Gang)

[First place in each list, reputation +500, second place reputation +300, third place reputation +100]

Wang Shuo was surprised to see that he was on the list.

But then he thought, although his level was very low, the huge amount of wealth in his backpack must be an important basis for reference ranking, so he was relieved.
